South Metrosand Isle was one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. At the time of its existence, it was located to the northeast of Numpool Island. However, due to the construction of Numpool Terminal, this isle, alongside East San Isle and North Metrosand Isle were reclaimed by the Numpool Terminal. As a result, no trace of this isle's existence is found.

South Stem Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is also a constituent of the Note Group.

Location[]

South Stem Island is located to the east of North Stem Island and is the easternmost island of Note Group.

Originally, this island was named Stem Island. However, as time passes on, players begin to refer to the westernmost island in the original Note Group as Stem Island. In order to distinguish this island from the current Stem Island, this island is renamed South Stem Island.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station features the second set of Connecting Stations between Nazca Railway Stations with Abutment Island Station, with the first set being White Margin Station and East Margin Station.
  • This Station is the first Oceanfloor Station at which the Platforms are located beneath the seabed.[4]
  • This Station features a passageway above the platform level featuring three elevators and providing access between Exit D Concourse, Concourse, Platforms and Abutment Island Station.[5]

History[]

  • November 6 2018: This Station began services.
  • February 10 2019: Exit E is added to this station.[6]

Southend Station is a station on Sava Line and Phoenix Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 204 Southend NR Station and SLT Line 203, Line 204 Southpark stops.

Fifth Anniversary Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0
  • Just walk along the Sava Line Concourse to find souvenir.
  • The Fifth Anniversary Souvenir comes in the form of The Door of Sincerity.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Door of Sincerity is a special souvenir that could only be obtained from this station.
  • The Sava Line Part of this station alludes to Heng On Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.[4]
  • The Sava Line Platforms were originally 152m long, but have since been extended to 204m long during the Phoenix Line Extension.
  • The Heightened Basic Platform Gates At the Sava Line Platforms are not added until the Phoenix Line Extension.
  • Before the Phoenix Line Extension, this station is the only station in Sava Line between Savanna Central Station and North Mountain Station with three distinct floors.

History[]

  • July 23 2016: This station began services alongside Sava Line.
  • October 7 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • May 16 2023: This station began expansion of the Phoenix Line Part.
  • May 19 2023: Sava Line Platforms have extended from 152m to 204m.
  • May 21 2023: This station completed expansion. At the same day, Phoenix Line extends from The Three Pass Station to this station.
  • April 5 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[6]

Southern Corridor is one of the lines in Period 4 of the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It runs between Summer Point and Charm River, and it currently has 25 stations. This line also features direct services with Hook Sand Line and an express service with seven stations which in turn features direct services with Hook Sand Express.

Contents

  • 1 History
    • 1.1 Timeline
  • 2 Districts Served
  • 3 Line Characteristics
  • 4 Future Development
  • 5 List of Stations
  • 6 Gallery
  • 7 Citations and References

History[]

Original plans of this line originates at Wong E-Tech and terminates at Litchi Lake, with the selling point being the fact that it passes through numerous interchanges through Comic Ward, West Metropolis Archipelago, Oasis and Punctual. However, in Period 4 of the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme, only the section between Wong E-Tech and Shony Island was approved. Meanwhile, one of the stations was renamed Sandy Heights Station to compliment development.

Subsequently, the then-developer of Tripaw left Project Nazca due to historical reasons, and Nawis Railway decided to develop Old Brightland in order to restore Tripaw development, using Southern Corridor as the only external connection at the time.

While original plans have seen this line extending to Kelper Mount through Sharpness Plains and Upper Oasis, the establishment of Daybreaker Line meant that this line is rerouted to Oasis Bay, and proposals of direct services with Hook Sand Line of Element Hub Transit are made and approved on January 24 2023.

On the same day, the westbound extension to Summer Point within Twenty-Second Continent was also approved, with the following changes:

  • Rapid Services would stop at Sandy Heights Station
  • Rapid Services would no longer stop at Wong E-Tech Station and Tenbal Island Station.
  • Express Services are also featured, which would only stop at Python Delta, Java Beach, Old Brightland, Howard Canyon, Prosand and Rapid Rivulet.

Timeline[]

  • 2018:
    • March 22: Phase I construction approved[1].
    • April 10: Phase I began services.
    • September 6: Phase II Construction approved[2].
  • 2020:
    • February 5: Phase II began services.
  • 2022:
    • March 4: Wong E-Tech Station reconstructed due to future extension works.
  • 2023:
    • March 11: Phase III (Summer Point - Charm River) constructions completed.

Districts Served[]

  • Twenty-Second Continent
  • West Metropolis Archipelago
    • Tenbal Island
    • Shony Island
  • TriPaw
  • Oasis Bay

Line Characteristics[]

  • The stations in the TriPaw section of this line has undergone multiple name changes, with Mount Galileo Station being renamed twice.
  • While original plans of this line only involved Miner North Station and TriPaw Station in TriPaw, due to redevelopment in Tripaw, this plan has been modified to the current stage.
  • Twenty Village Station of Nazca Railway already had reserved structure for this line upon construction.

Future Development[]

This line will extend to the west and enter Cityyard Shrine in Teraleros. Moreover, to complement development plans in the Twenty-Second Continent, the section between Comic Ward Station and Sandy Heights Station will also be rerouted with an extra station added in between.

Southern Line was the tenth line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between Isles Forest and Area Sixtythree, and had a total of 12 stations. It was established alongside South Point Station on February 28 2014. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description[]

Southern Line was the tenth District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled along the south coast of Tremend Sea and the south coast of Terracept Continent.

This line was represented by the Yellow Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 9.

At the time of its closure, this route was 14.81 km long, with a total of 12 stations.

Southern Loop is a line of New View Railway.[1][2] The only existing section runs between Crane Island and Rollhill Island. While this line was originally built to serve islands that have yet to have railway access, Stadow Line overlapped with most of the existing line.

History[]

  • May 1 2017: Kasukano Train Railway shuts down, and this line is taken over by Los Sengas Government.
  • June 4 2018: This line became a part of the Co-Op Railway.
  • 2024: The section between Bonyal Peninsula and Lean Forest is rendered inaccessible due to redevelopment.

Districts Served[]

  • West Metropolis Archipelago

Line Characteristics[]

  • Original plans of this line involved multiple branches.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Middle Island branch only runs in one direction. In other words, passengers can travel from Middle Island Station to Rollhill Island Station, but not the other way round.
  • This line originally had plans to stop at West Shoal, Pan-Ward and Haber Island as well. However, due to routing conflicts with Nazca Railway and Nazca Ferry Co. Ltd., the plans to set up these stations are aborted.

Southern Peck Line was one of the lines in Period 5 of the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It was planned to have nine stations, and was ran by Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu. It ran between Silver Plateau and Yakumo Estate.

History[]

  • September 6 2018: Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu (Then named Mass Transport Railway System Company) gained approval to build this line.
  • October 25 2022: Peckern South-East Coast Line was established to replace this line.

title: Spade Valley Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Spade Valley Stabling Sidings is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for Stadium Line and Bravo Line. It is located beneath Spade Valley Station. This Stabling Siding is designed to support Katadelphia Depot, and has a capacity of eight trains.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
    • 1.3 Other Facts
  • 2 Gallery
  • 3 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

The two sides have eight sidings each, which can store eight trains, including three Bravo Line trains and five Stadium Line trains.

Connecting Tracks[]

The Stadium Line tracks enable trains to standby in both directions, and trains can go directly to Spade Valley Station from there. However, the Bravo Line tracks only lead to Purity Corner Station. Spurs are also set up on each track.

Other Facts[]

Besides of increasing the capacity for Stadium Line and Bravo Line, this Stabling Siding is also constructed with enhancing Stadium Line and Bravo Line dispatch frequencies in mind. The trains parked in this Stabling Siding are also managed by Katadelphia Depot.

Description[]

Sparkling Line is one of the District lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It starts from Centopia and enters Xofa from its center.

This route is represented by Purple on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 12.

Currently, this route is 10.21 km long, with a total of 7 stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first station in Los Sengas Division to be located to the west of Intus Occident (X = -20000).
  • When this station was constructed, the Station Number of Sparkling Line was 12-04. However, due to the construction of Enning Station and to reserve room for future Centopia development, the Station Number is now 12-05.[3]
  • This Station is named after the fact that it passes through the north of Sparkling Lake.[4]

History[]

  • August 7 2019: This Station began services.
  • November 7 2020: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[5]
  • December 31 2022: Due to the construction of Enning Station and future Centopia development, the Station Number of Sparkling Line has changed.[6]

  • This Station was already named during the construction of Jasmine Beach Station, which has the same namesake as this station with regards that it is named after Princess Jasmine. However, the name of this station comes from the character song of Jasmine with the Same Name in the real-life adaptation of Aladdin.[2]
  • To correspond to the name of this station, there are multiple elements that denote the number Zero, ranging from the oval shape at the background of the Station Name Banner, to the round-edged ceilings at the platform.[3]

History[]

  • December 28 2022: This station completed construction.[4]
  • December 29 2022: This station began services.
  • August 24 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after the fact that it lays at the south end of an Ice Spikes biome.

History[]

  • December 10 2016: This station began services alongside Flask Line, but East Ring Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • December 20 2016: East Ring Line extends from Cold Stream Station to this station.
  • July 7 2018: Due to misuse of commands from an administrator, Glacier Station was closed for more than three hours. During that time period, Flask Line terminates here.[2]
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • July 24 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station, along with Weaving Plate Station, are stations that are related to Weaving. Pink Wool is used in this station as Pink is usually associated with weaving.[2]
  • Even before the establishment of Kilo Line, reserved structure for interchanging could already be seen. The concourse of this station is set underground in order to facilitiate future interchanging.

History[]

  • August 22 2017: This station began services alongside East Ring Line.
  • February 18 2018: This station completed expansion of the Kilo Line section.
  • February 19 2018: Kilo Line is established.

title: Splended River Bridge
safeHtml:
Splended River Bridge is a bridge that spans Splended River, and is an important transport link between Flask and Yowah. The two ends connect to Sunrise Road and Splended River Boulevard respectively.

The bridge is a part of Splended River Boulevard.

History[]

  • Between April and June 2016: Splended River Bridge completed construction, connecting to Kong On Street as a two lane single carriageway.
  • March 18 2017: This bridge has been converetd to a two-lane dual-carriageway and is now connected to Splended River Boulevard.

Significance[]

  • Splended River Bridge spans Splended River and connects Grass Crack in Flask with Yowah Point in Yowah, and serves as an important transport route besides of Nazca Railway and other Co-Op Railways

Citations and References []

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate Samuel, the owner of Inter-Galactic Media Group, photobombing into the Second Ride Video of S2E4, with the other two stations being Allied Town Station and Lei Tiu Lau Station. The three stations are all represented by Sandstone, Stone Bricks, and a concrete of a certain color in terms of building material.
  • According to the Railway Builder, the Chinese Name of this station alludes to Stupid Fox, and this name is used as Samuel called the Railway Builder a Stupid Fox.[2]
  • A private vehicle Pick-up/Drop-off Area is located outside Exit A, hence the Design of the Exit A Concourse.

History[]

  • August 19 2022: This station began services.

Spring Point Gateway is a gateway on Oasis Bay Line, Daybreaker Line, Starshore Line and Kilo Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Prymea. This station will serve Union Circular and Echo Line in the future, and passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 2602, Line 2603L, Line 2604, Line 2605, Line 2611, Line 3803 Spring Point and SLT Line 2602, Line 2603L 500th Avenue stops.

Station Characteristics[]

  • This station is the 500th station to be built in the Los Sengas Division.
  • This station is one of the Group 2 Gateways of Nazca Railway, and is located at approximately 20 km to the southeast of Metropolis Terminal.[3]
  • This station is the permanent upbound terminus of Daybreaker Line.
  • This station is the first Gateway with multiple color schemes. Besides of the Lime Concrete that signifies the Season of Spring like in other Group 2 Gateways, the Pink Wool that signifies Cherry Blossoms in Spring is also added.
  • As the last Group 2 Gateway to be built, the Style, Design and Facilities of this Station has adopted various elements from Fall Point, Summer Point and Winter Point:
    • The overall decor and the Stone Bricks at the waterfall resembles Fall Point;
    • The Bus Terminus next to the Station resembles Summer Point;
    • Besides of the fact that this Station does not feature Cross-Platform Interchange, the Station Park Outside this Station and the Platform arrangements resemble Winter Point;
    • The Shopping Street and its arrangement is similar to Summer Point and Winter Point.

Fun Facts[]

  • This page is the 3200th page of this wiki.
  • All Group 2 Gateways make use of a shape at the sides of its walls. This Station uses Lozenges.
  • According to the Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition, prior to the construction of this station, it has already been confirmed that Oasis Bay Line, Daybreaker Line, Starshore Line and Kilo Line will pass through this station, with Daybreaker Line using this station as the permanent Up Direction Terminus. Moreover, the news of Union Circular and Echo Line serving this station is first confirmed in a Discord Exclusive Announcement on December 28 2025.[4]
  • Among all Group 2 Gateways, this Gateway is the only Station that is NOT located next to a body of water.[5]
  • Due to the fact that there are two main Building Materials in this Station, which are Pink Wool and Light Green Concrete, Pink Wool are used at the back together with Light Gray Concrete behind the wall next to the tracks[6] and Pink Stained Glass appears behind the tracks of the Upper Platforms, whereas Light Green Concrete and Light Green Stained Glass appear and replace Pink Wool in the Lower Platforms. However, since this station also uses Oak Leaves behind the Glass for both floors of platforms, the wall representative design is less obviously seen.
  • The Exits in this Station are arranged in a clockwise fashion.
  • Despite being the last Group 2 Gateway to be built, this Station is the first Group 2 Gateway in which a line (Oasis Bay Line, S4E11) has both directions available for boarding, as all other lines that served any Group 2 Gateway were terminating at the respective gateway(s) before S4E11.

History[]

  • April 15 2026: This Station began construction.
  • April 20 2026: This Station completed construction.
  • April 21 2026: This Station began services alongside Kilo Line, but Daybreaker Line, Starshore Line, Oasis Bay Line, Union Circular and Echo Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • May 8 2026: Starshore Line extends from Firstflare Station to this station.
  • May 9 2026: The Station Mascot of this station is added.
  • June 30 2026: Daybreaker Line extends from Sampin Villages Station to this station through Mount Qin West Station. Daybreaker Line completed development.
  • July 30 2026: Oasis Bay Line extends from Pinewatch Station to this station through Mount Qin West Station.
